{{Quote|Okay, Jedi, here comes the nice camp commander. Look sullen and recalcitrant.|[[Sull]], to [[Bardan Jusik]]|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
A '''clone trooper lieutenant''' of the [[55th Mechanized Brigade]] acted as the camp [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Pols Anaxes]] [[Republic Detention Center]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after getting an injury that that made [[Gender/Legends|him]] walk stiffly. Upon meeting the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] thought that the [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant's]] skills were being wasted running a [[Prison/Legends|prison]], but quickly realized that he was assigned to that position due to his injuries, which made Fi hopeful of his own recovery after getting injured at the [[Battle of Gaftikar]].<ref name="Order 66" />
